title: Compute criterion satisfaction and independent acceptance from the recorded evidence
goal: Make AcceptanceAuthority apply A7 and A8 exactly, distinguishing independent approval, criterion satisfaction and strength of confirmation.
scope: Implement Acceptance Accepted/Rejected(reason), per-criterion grades and required-criterion minimum grade. Filter reviews/evidence for applicability to this result, criterion/check versions and run environment before polarity or grading; applicable Contradicts Executed/Browser/ExternalData defeats approval. Require a Reviewer distinct from the actual producer.

Implement Unconfirmed, Discriminated and Confirmed(TrustedCheck/ExternalData/Consequences) representations with A7 predicates; only currently supported bases may create grades. Hidden discrimination is exercised in W2, consequence regrading in W5. Do not grant a grade because a reviewer claims it.

Implement CriteriaLedger/LedgerEntry and BeliefModel.update(entry,evidence,criterion,subject:Ref). A8 first filters applicability, then applies contradiction precedence; supporting contains only applicable Supports. Default LikelihoodRatioTable uses prior 0.5, counts each correlated (independence,class,discrimination) group once, and requires nonempty supporting plus needs_class coverage and threshold for Satisfied.

Keep the BeliefModel interface replaceable, with versioned initial LR/threshold parameters and a substantially different experimental implementation. Any experimental prior is finite within (0,1), explicitly about the current criterion/result and supported by a recorded basis; an assignment-success forecast is not such a prior. Implement Confirmed-only CreditPolicy and an alternative also crediting Discriminated, selectable for an experiment; actual observations belong to W5-0001.

Connect a real W1-0008 candidate and independent W1-0009 review/evidence to AcceptanceAuthority.accept, then pass its committed acceptance reference to W1-0007 Arbiter discharge. Rejection or unrelated acceptance cannot discharge the artifact commitment.
acceptance: The real acceptance consumer accepts an independently approved passing candidate with the justified grade and rejects applicable executable contradiction despite multiple approving reviews. Producer self-review never qualifies.

Old/unrelated support and contradiction are excluded before A7/A8. Repeating one correlated group cannot inflate belief; a high prior alone or missing positive needs_class coverage cannot satisfy a criterion. The default producer execution + independent inspection + static-read example remains about 0.71 for NewBehavior.

Select different BeliefModel implementations through the real ledger consumer without rewriting it, retaining resolved parameters/input/basis. Experiment-scoped priors cannot bypass applicable contradiction or Supports coverage. CreditPolicy variants give distinct attributable eligibility; changing selection does not rewrite grades or earlier observations.

A real producer result independently Accepted by A7 discharges exactly its artifact commitment; Rejected, forged, stale or another subject’s acceptance leaves that commitment undischargeable. This completes the P2 artifact seam without requiring W1-0007 to produce acceptance.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.6, 4 (AcceptanceAuthority), 5.2 (BeliefModel), 5.6 (CreditPolicy), A7/A8, R-4/R-6/R-11. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Implement proposed crates/ymp-kernel/src/{acceptance,ledger}.rs and crates/ymp-runtime/src/policies/belief.rs. W1-0008/0009 provide real immutable candidates, checks and reviews; W1-0007 provides the commitment transition consumer. Own actual candidate acceptance, A8 ledger and acceptance-to-discharge integration.

Retain BeliefModel, default LikelihoodRatioTable prior=0.5 and subject:Ref. An experimental prior must mean present criterion/result satisfaction, never future assignment success. Filter applicability before polarity, count correlated support once and require nonempty applicable Supports coverage. A7 acceptance, A8 satisfaction and CreditPolicy remain distinct.

Select materially different BeliefModel implementations through the same consumer with recoverable parameters/basis. Implement both CreditPolicy variants as selectable policy values here; W5-0001 consumes them for real observations. W1-0013 handles final aggregates.

history.note: Plan new implementation from greenfield baseline 0c61ff1, preserving approved experimental mechanisms, reporting/evidence/recovery rules and explicit prerequisite boundaries.
